info.title: Scratchpad HTTP API
info.description: Source contract for Scratchpad, including SQLite/PostgreSQL parity, optional AI and optional public GitHub profile enrichment. Browser requests authenticate with an HttpOnly same-site cookie; MCP authenticates with an opaque bearer token. Browser mutations require the configured origin. GitHub profile linkage is descriptive public information. Optional administrator-configured GitHub OAuth separately authenticates the one owner by stable account ID and synchronizes published SSH authentication/signing keys. Complete snapshots are refreshed every five minutes, cached for less than 24 hours, and enforce persistent local blocks and revocation on every managed request. Setup/recovery tokens are local administrator capabilities. JSON bodies are capped at 8 MiB except /import (64 MiB; JSONL text 32 MiB). Flexible original payload and provenance remain preserved.

post.summary: Begin browser-bound GitHub OAuth with PKCE
post.description: Expected Origin required. setup needs an initial single-use setupToken; recover needs a distinct administrator recovery setupToken. link requires an authenticated browser; replace requires browser authentication less than five minutes old. login requires an existing verified binding. The HttpOnly SameSite=Lax state cookie binds the single-use callback to this browser.

302.description: Establishes browser session and redirects to the dashboard; sets HttpOnly session cookie and clears state cookie

303.description: Failed authorization redirects to the dashboard with authError set to a fixed safe error code; no upstream message, token or private data is exposed.

get.summary: Verified GitHub binding, complete cache freshness and key blocking status

delete.summary: Unlink GitHub using fresh independent local browser authentication
delete.description: Authentication proof must be less than five minutes old. Invalidates GitHub-derived permissions and sessions, preserving independent local credentials and project knowledge. Administrator recovery can restore independent passkey access first.

post.summary: Refresh the complete synchronized GitHub SSH key cache
post.description: Failed, incomplete or malformed responses preserve the previous complete snapshot and its age. Removed keys invalidate existing managed sessions. Late responses cannot overwrite a newer synchronization or replaced binding.

post.summary: Persistently block or explicitly unblock canonical SSH key material
post.description: Blocks take effect immediately across credentials carrying the same canonical key identity and survive restart, synchronization and removal/readdition. Unblocking does not restore previously invalidated sessions or stale eligibility.

mcpBearer.description: Opaque session token; not necessarily a JWT.

apiKey.description: Omit to preserve the stored key; empty string removes it.

warnings.description: Audited suggestions omitted for insufficient evidence; valid siblings remain available.

GithubProfile.description: Public GitHub profile snapshot; not an authenticated identity.

PrivacyDependencies.description: Server-owned complete inputs, separate from display citations. Absent on historical artifacts with unknown provenance; such artifacts cannot be retrieved or reviewed as suggestions.

Error.description: Stable JSON error envelope. Common codes: AUTH_REQUIRED, AUTH_INVALID, AUTH_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED, AUTH_CHALLENGE_USED, VALIDATION_FAILED, CONFLICT, PROJECT_NOT_FOUND, PROJECT_IDENTITY_REQUIRED, PROJECT_IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS, AI_DISABLED, AI_NOT_ALLOWED, AI_UNAVAILABLE, AI_SCOPE_TOO_LARGE, DATABASE_NOT_READY. Additional codes may be introduced.
